decisions.summary: BAMBOO_SHADE_FT its own constant, derived from the timber bamboos' least cited height (10 m, R0/R2) by the canopy reach's derivation: 50 ft
decisions.why: FR-002 verbatim; the GM's 'the distance away that it would have to be' answered from bamboo's own height; the canopy reach is reckoned at the same 10 m (tree_shade.py line 20), so equal values follow from the derivation, not an alias

decisions.summary: _sun_keepouts takes a reach parameter, default the canopy reach
decisions.why: mechanism for FR-002/FR-003; changes no existing caller

decisions.summary: culm marks in _draw_grove tested against the sun boxes at bamboo's reach; every inked mark recorded in M['bamboo_marks']; the 'maybe bamboo' comment rewritten
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-003, FR-004 for the grove/windbreak/belt marks, the one placer (groves.py:744) that draws them

decisions.summary: household_bamboo refuses a strip meeting a sun box (next side tried); bamboo_seats adds sun boxes to its obstacle index; a stand refused everywhere is not drawn
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-003 for both stand placers (the only callers, hinterland/stages.py:157-158); the unseated stand is the spec's own Edge Case

decisions.summary: bamboo_shading_plots over marks (discs) and stands (outline boxes); gate test asserts zero with non-vacuity and record count = SVG culm count; cohort audit reads it; new key classified in taxonomy and cover skip
decisions.why: FR-005, SC-001, SC-002, SC-003; the box for a stand is conservative (stricter, not narrower); the taxonomy entries are bookkeeping for FR-004's key

decisions.summary: sun page's bamboo bullet rewritten with footnoted heights and yadake placed; tree_shade docstring; ThreshingYard and Garden modals; bamboo pages via entry-drift
decisions.why: FR-006, SC-004; a grep finds the exemption stated only on 0038's drawing page (line 38), tree_shade.py:10, groves.py:662 and homestead.py:181/221, all named in D3/D6; 0075 states no exemption

decisions.summary: no review occasion declared because no pool bamboo moves (R0); declared if a regenerated map's bamboo moves
decisions.why: project process, not a reduction of the request; the rule is held by the D5 gate test on every map
